long_description:
Millennial Events presents Ghayal, a brand-new Hindi stand-up comedy show by Pranit More.

In Ghayal, Pranit takes audiences through the journey of his life—the people, places, relationships, and unexpected incidents that have shaped his personality and the way he sees the world. From growing up and navigating everyday life to the unforgettable moments that made headlines, Pranit brings his experiences to the stage through candid storytelling, sharp observations, and his distinctive comedic style.

Personal, honest, and packed with humour, Ghayal offers audiences a closer look at the stories behind the comedian. Whether they have followed Pranit’s journey for years or are seeing him perform live for the first time, audiences can expect an entertaining evening filled with stories, surprises, and stand-up comedy.

Whether you’re planning a night out with friends, family, or attending solo, this high-energy live performance promises nonstop entertainment and moments you’ll be talking about long after the show ends. If you’re looking to unwind and enjoy quality comedy, you won’t want to miss this show.
